lastCompletedStory.title: Deliver worker task prompts out-of-band via per-dispatch prompt file

nextStoryContext: All planner, auditor, implementer, reviewer, and Codex task prompts now flow through one reaping per-dispatch file under the project .claude directory. Production dispatch sites pass claudeDir explicitly; adapter-only callers use an isolated process-scoped tmp fallback. POSIX command substitution intentionally strips trailing newline bytes, and the real-subprocess boundary test pins that policy.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Only Node.js standard-library filesystem, path, and subprocess APIs were used; no external library was touched.
